derivation: LIFE-010 makes clock_revision nonnull exactly when budget_inputs is nonempty, and it identifies the latest retained available lifecycle clock for the registry clock source, here revision 1 at 04:30:00Z. The evidence timeline rule then requires native_evidence.observed_at to be no later than that selected clock for every budget-backed effect. The observation at 04:31:00Z is later, so the transition is CLOCK_INVALID. PROTOCOL places CLOCK_INVALID in the common lifecycle admission-refusal vocabulary, so no proposal record, outcome or decision receipt is appended and the supplied work and registry states are returned unchanged. WCS2-006 leaves retention of the raw evidence and resubmission after admitting a current clock to the host, outside the consumer result.
